Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتَأَبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُّلْطَانِ
Translation: O Allah, O Owner of Everlasting Dominion and Authority

Arabic text: اَلْمُمْتَنِعِ بِغَيْرِ جُنُودٍ وَلَا أَعْوَانٍ
Translation: Who needs no armies or helpers

Arabic text: وَالْعِزِّ الْبَاقِيْ عَلَى مَرِّ الدُّهُورِ
Translation: Whose glory remains throughout the passage of ages

Arabic text: وَخَوَالِيْ الْاَعْوَامِ، وَمَوَاضِيْ الْاَزْمَانِ وَالْأَيَّامِ
Translation: Through the passing years, times, and days

Arabic text: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزًّا لَا حَدَّ لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلَا مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ
Translation: Your authority is so mighty that it has no beginning limit nor any ending boundary

Arabic text: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوًّا سَقَطَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ دُوْنَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
Translation: Your dominion is so exalted that all things fall short of reaching its extent

Arabic text: وَلَا يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ
Translation: Even the highest praise of those who praise cannot reach the least of what You alone possess

Arabic text: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسَّخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ
Translation: All descriptions fail to comprehend You, and all attributes fall short before You

Arabic text: وَحَارَتْ فِيْ كِبْرِيَائِكَ لَطَائِفُ الَاوْهَامِ
Translation: The subtlest imaginations are bewildered by Your greatness

Arabic text: كَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْاَوَّلُ فِيْ أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ
Translation: Such are You, Allah, the First in Your eternity

Arabic text: وَعَلَى ذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لَا تَزُولُ
Translation: And thus You remain forever, never ceasing to be

Arabic text: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلًا الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلًا
Translation: And I am the servant, weak in deeds yet great in hopes

Arabic text: خَرَجَتْ مِنْ يَدِيْ أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَتِ إِلَّا مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ
Translation: The means of connection have slipped from my hands, except what Your mercy has connected

Arabic text: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ عَنِّيْ عِصَمُ الْآمَالِ
Translation: The bonds of hope have been severed from me

Arabic text: إِلَّا مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: Except what I cling to of Your forgiveness

Arabic text: قَلَّ عِنْدِيْ مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: Little is what I count as my obedience to You

Arabic text: وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And great is what burdens me from my disobedience to You

Arabic text: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَ اِنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Translation: Yet pardoning Your servant will not constrain You, even if he did evil, so forgive me

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى خَفَايَا الْاَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ
Translation: O Allah, Your knowledge encompasses the hidden aspects of deeds

Arabic text: وَانْكَشَفَ كُلُّ مَسْتُوْرٍ دُوْنَ خُبْرِكَ
Translation: And everything concealed is exposed to Your awareness

Arabic text: وَلَا تَنْطَوِيْ عَنْكَ دَقَائِقُ الْأُمُورِ
Translation: The subtle details of matters are not hidden from You

Arabic text: وَلَا تَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ غَيِّبَاتُ السَّرَائِرِ
Translation: And the secrets of hearts do not elude You

Arabic text: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِيْ اسْتَنْظَرَكَ لِغَوَايَتِيْ فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ
Translation: Your enemy has taken control of me - the one who asked Your permission to mislead me, and You allowed him

Arabic text: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لِأَضْلاَلِيْ فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ
Translation: He asked for respite until the Day of Judgment to lead me astray, and You granted it

Arabic text: فَاَوْقَعَنِيْ وَقَدْ هَرَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: So he trapped me even as I fled to You

Arabic text: مِنْ صَغَائِرِ ذُنُوبٍ مُوبِقَةٍ
Translation: From small destructive sins

Arabic text: وَكَبَائِرِ أَعْمَالٍ مُرْدِيَـةٍ
Translation: And major ruinous deeds

Arabic text: حَتَّى إِذَا قَارَفْتُ مَعْصِيَتَـكَ
Translation: Until when I committed acts of disobedience to You

Arabic text: وَاسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِسُوءِ سَعْيِيْ سَخْطَتَكَ
Translation: And deserved Your wrath through my evil efforts

Arabic text: فَتَلَ عَنِّيْ عِذَارَ غَدْرِهِ
Translation: He removed from me the bridle of his deceit

Arabic text: وَتَلَقَّانِيْ بِكَلِمَةِ كُفْرِهِ
Translation: And confronted me with words of his disbelief

Arabic text: وَتَوَلَّى الْبَرَاءَةَ مِنِّيْ وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيًا عَنِّي
Translation: He disavowed me and turned his back, fleeing from me

Arabic text: فَأَصْحَرنِيْ لِغَضَبِكَ فَرِيدًا
Translation: So he exposed me alone to Your anger

Arabic text: وَأَخْرَجَنِيْ إِلَى فِنَاءِ نَقِمَتِكَ طَرِيدًا
Translation: And drove me out as an outcast to the courtyard of Your vengeance

Arabic text: لَا شَفِيعٌ يَشْفَعُ لِيْ إِلَيْـكَ
Translation: With no intercessor to plead for me before You

Arabic text: وَلَا خَفِيـرٌ يُؤْمِنُنِيْ عَلَيْـكَ
Translation: No protector to grant me security against You

Arabic text: وَلَا حِصْنٌ يَحْجُبُنِيْ عَنْكَ
Translation: No fortress to shield me from You

Arabic text: وَلَا مَلَاَذٌ أَلْجَأُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْكَ
Translation: No refuge to which I might flee from You

Arabic text: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ
Translation: This is the position of one seeking refuge in You, and the place of one who confesses to You

Arabic text: فَلَا يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّيْ فَضْلُكَ، وَلَا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِيْ عَفْوُكَ
Translation: So let not Your grace be too narrow for me, and let not Your pardon fall short of me

Arabic text: وَلَا أكُنْ أَخْيَبَ عِبَادِكَ التَّائِبِينَ
Translation: Let me not be the most disappointed of Your repentant servants

Arabic text: وَلَا أَقْنَطَ وفُودِكَ الْآمِلِينَ
Translation: Nor the most despairing of those who hope in You

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ إِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ
Translation: Forgive me, for You are the Best of Forgivers

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِيْ فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِيْ فَرَكِبْتُ
Translation: O Allah, You commanded me but I abandoned, You forbade me but I committed

Arabic text: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ
Translation: Evil thoughts made error seem appealing to me, so I was negligent

Arabic text: وَلَا أَسْتَشْهِدُ عَلَى صِيَامِيْ نَهَـارًا
Translation: I cannot call upon witnesses for my fasting during the day

Arabic text: وَلَا أَسْتَجِيرُ بِتَهَجُّدِيْ لَيْلًا
Translation: Nor can I seek protection through my night vigils

Arabic text: وَلَا تُثْنِيْ عَلَيَّ بِإِحْيَائِهَا سُنَّةٌ
Translation: No Sunnah practice can commend me for reviving it

Arabic text: حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِيْ مَنْ ضَيَّعَهَا هَلَكَ
Translation: Except Your obligatory duties, which whoever neglects is ruined

Arabic text: وَلَسْتُ أَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِفَضْلِ نَافِلَة
Translation: I cannot appeal to You through the excellence of optional devotions

Arabic text: مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ
Translation: Given how much I have neglected of Your obligatory duties

Arabic text: وَتَعَدَّيْتُ عَنْ مَقَامَاتِ حُدُودِكَ
Translation: And how I have transgressed beyond the stations of Your limits

Arabic text: إِلَى حُرُمَاتٍ انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوبٍ اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
Translation: To sacred things I have violated, and major sins I have committed

Arabic text: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِيْ مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْرًا
Translation: Your protection was a covering for me from their scandal

Arabic text: وَهٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ
Translation: This is the position of one who is ashamed before You for himself

Arabic text: وَسَخِطَ عَلَيْهَا، وَرَضِيَ عَنْكَ
Translation: Who is displeased with himself, yet pleased with You

Arabic text: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْسٍ خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَةٍ خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْرٍ مُثْقَلٍ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
Translation: So he comes to You with a humble soul, a submissive neck, and a back burdened with sins

Arabic text: وَاقِفًا بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ
Translation: Standing between hope in You and fear of You

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ أَوْلَى مَنْ رَجَـاهُ
Translation: And You are the most worthy of those in whom he hopes

Arabic text: وَأَحَقُّ مَنْ خَشِيَـهُ وَاتَّقَـاهُ
Translation: And the most deserving of those whom he fears and is cautious of

Arabic text: فَاعْطِنِيْ يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَ آمِنِّيْ مَا حَذِرْتُ
Translation: So grant me, O Lord, what I hope for, and secure me from what I dread

Arabic text: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إِنَّكَ أَكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُوْلِينَ
Translation: And bestow upon me the benefits of Your mercy, for You are the Most Generous of those who are asked

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَإِذْ سَتَـرْتَنِيْ بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِيْ بِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: O Allah, since You have covered me with Your pardon and enveloped me in Your grace

Arabic text: فِيْ دَارِ الْفَنَاءِ بِحَضرَةِ الْأَكْفَاءِ
Translation: In this transient world in the presence of my peers

Arabic text: فَأَجِرْنِيْ مِنْ فَضِيحَاتِ دَارِ الْبَقَاءِ
Translation: Then protect me from the disgraces of the eternal abode

Arabic text: عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الْأَشْهَادِ مِنَ المَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
Translation: At the stations where witnesses stand - the close angels

Arabic text: وَالرُّسُلِ الْمُكَرَّمِيْنَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِيْنَ
Translation: The honored messengers, the martyrs, and the righteous

Arabic text: مِنْ جَارٍ كُنْتُ أُكَاتِمُهُ سَيِّئاتِي
Translation: From a neighbor from whom I used to hide my sins

Arabic text: وَمِنْ ذِيْ رَحِمٍ كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِيْ سَرِيرَاتِي
Translation: And from a relative from whom I was shy regarding my private affairs

Arabic text: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِيْ السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ
Translation: I did not trust them, my Lord, to cover me

Arabic text: وَوَثِقْتُ بِكَ رَبِّ فِيْ الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ
Translation: But I trusted in You, my Lord, to forgive me

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ اَوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And You are the most worthy of being trusted and the most generous to those who seek from You

Arabic text: وَأَرْأَفُ مَنِ اسْتُرْحِمَ فَارْحَمْنِي
Translation: And the most compassionate of those from whom mercy is sought, so have mercy on me

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْتَ حَدَرْتَنِيْ مَاءً مَهِينًا مِنْ صُلْبٍ
Translation: O Allah, You made me descend as a humble fluid from a spine

Arabic text: مُتَضَائِقِ الْعِظَامِ حَرِجِ الْمَسَالِكِ
Translation: With narrow bones and constricted passages

Arabic text: إِلَى رَحِم ضَيِّقَة سَتَرْتَهَا بِالْحُجُبِ
Translation: To a narrow womb which You covered with veils

Arabic text: تُصَرِّفُنِيْ حَالًاَ عَنْ حَال حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إِلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ
Translation: You transformed me from state to state until You brought me to the completion of form

Arabic text: وَأَثْبَتَّ فِيَّ الْجَوَارحَ
Translation: And established in me the limbs

Arabic text: كَمَا نَعَتَّ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ
Translation: As You described in Your Book

Arabic text: نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَامًا
Translation: A drop, then a clot, then a lump, then bones

Arabic text: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِيْ خَلْقًا آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ
Translation: Then You clothed the bones with flesh, then created me as another creature as You willed

Arabic text: حَتَّى إِذَا احْتَجْتُ إِلَى رِزْقِكَ
Translation: Until when I needed Your provision

Arabic text: وَلَمْ أَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ غِيَـاثِ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: And could not dispense with the aid of Your grace

Arabic text: جَعَلْتَ لِيْ قُـوَّتًا مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب
Translation: You made for me sustenance from the abundance of food and drink

Arabic text: أَجْرَيْتَهُ لِأَمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِيْ جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِيْ قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا
Translation: Which You provided for Your maidservant in whose belly You lodged me and in whose womb You deposited me

Arabic text: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِيْ يَا رَبِّ فِيْ تِلْكَ الْحَـالَاتِ إِلَى حَوْلِي
Translation: If You had entrusted me, O Lord, in those states to my own strength

Arabic text: أَوْ تَضْطَرُّنِيْ إِلَى قُوّتي
Translation: Or forced me to rely on my own power

Arabic text: لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّيْ مُعْتَزِلًا، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّيْ بَعِيدَةً
Translation: Strength would have been far from me, and power would have been distant from me

Arabic text: فَغَذَوْتَنِيْ بِفَضْلِكَ غِذَاءَ البَرِّ اللَّطِيفِ
Translation: So You nourished me by Your grace with the nourishment of the tender, kind one

Arabic text: تَفْعَلُ ذٰلِكَ بِيْ تَطَوُّلًا عَلَيَّ إِلَى غَايَتِيْ هَذِهِ
Translation: You did that for me out of Your favor until this present time

Arabic text: لَا أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلَا يُبْطِئُ بِيْ حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ
Translation: I do not lack Your goodness, nor is Your beneficence slow to reach me

Arabic text: وَلَا تَتَأَكَّدُ مَعَ ذٰلِكَ ثِقَتِي
Translation: Yet with all that, my confidence does not become firm

Arabic text: فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: So that I might devote myself to what is more favorable for me with You

Arabic text: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِيْ فِيْ سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ
Translation: Satan has gained control over me through evil thoughts and weak certainty

Arabic text: فَأَنَا أَشْكُوْ سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِيْ وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِيْ لَـهُ
Translation: I complain of his evil companionship with me and my soul's obedience to him

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ صَرْفِ كَيْدِهِ عَنِّيْ
Translation: I seek Your protection from his dominion, and I implore You to turn his schemes away from me

Arabic text: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ فِيْ أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إِلَى رِزْقِيْ سَبِيْلًا
Translation: And I ask You to make easy the path to my provision

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ
Translation: So to You belongs praise for initiating great blessings

Arabic text: وَإِلْهَامِكَ الشُّكْرَ عَلَى الْإِحْسَانِ وَالْاِنْعَامِ
Translation: And inspiring gratitude for kindness and favor

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِيْ وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِيْ بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ
Translation: And make my provision easy for me, and make me content with what You have decreed for me

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تُرْضِيَنِيْ بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ
Translation: And make me satisfied with my portion in what You have apportioned for me

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
Translation: And make what has gone from my body and my life

Arabic text: فِيْ سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
Translation: To be in the path of obedience to You, for You are the Best of Providers

Arabic text: أَللَهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ
Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a fire with which You threatened those who disobeyed You

Arabic text: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ
Translation: And with which You warned those who turned away from Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نورُهَا ظُلْمَة وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ
Translation: From a fire whose light is darkness, whose easiest punishment is painful, whose distant torment is near

Arabic text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ يَأْكُلُ بَعْضَهَا بَعْضٌ
Translation: From a fire that consumes itself

Arabic text: وَيَصُولُ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْض
Translation: And its parts attack one another

Arabic text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ تَذَرُ الْعِظَامَ رَمِيمًا
Translation: From a fire that leaves bones decayed

Arabic text: وَتَسْقِيْ أَهْلَهَا حَمِيمًا
Translation: And gives its people scalding water to drink

Arabic text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لَا تُبْقِيْ عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إِلَيْهَا
Translation: From a fire that shows no mercy to those who humble themselves before it

Arabic text: وَلَا تَرْحَمُ مَنِ اسْتَعْطَفَهَا
Translation: And has no compassion for those who seek its sympathy

Arabic text: وَلَا تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إِلَيْهَا
Translation: It cannot lighten the punishment for those who submit to it and surrender to it

Arabic text: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيْدِ الْوَبَالِ
Translation: It meets its inhabitants with the most painful torment and severe punishment at its disposal

Arabic text: وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا
Translation: I seek refuge in You from its scorpions with gaping mouths

Arabic text: وَحَيَّاتِهَا الصَّالِقَةِ بِأَنْيَابِهَا
Translation: And its serpents striking with their fangs

Arabic text: وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِيْ يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ
Translation: And from its drink that tears apart the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants, and rips out their hearts

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا بَاعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا
Translation: I ask Your guidance to what keeps me away from it and distances me from it

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَ آلِـهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَجِرْنِيْ مِنْهَا بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And save me from it by the grace of Your mercy

Arabic text: وَأَقِلْنِيْ عَثَرَاتِيْ بِحُسْنِ إِقَالَتِكَ
Translation: And forgive my stumbles through Your goodly forgiveness

Arabic text: وَلَا تَخْذُلْنِيْ يَا خَيْرَ الْمُجيرِينَ
Translation: And do not forsake me, O Best of Protectors

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَقِيْ الْكَرِيهَةَ، وَتُعْطِيْ الْحَسَنَةَ
Translation: O Allah, You ward off harm and grant goodness

Arabic text: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: You do what You will, and You have power over all things

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، إِذَا ذُكِرَ الْأَبْرَارُ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family, whenever the righteous are mentioned

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
Translation: And bless Muhammad and his family as long as night and day alternate

Arabic text: صَلاَةً لَا يَنْقَطِعُ مَدَدُهَا
Translation: Blessings whose flow is unceasing

Arabic text: وَلَا يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ
Translation: And whose number cannot be counted, blessings that fill the atmosphere

Arabic text: وَتَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ وَالسَّمَاءَ
Translation: And cover the earth and sky

Arabic text: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَرْضَى
Translation: May Allah bless him until He is pleased

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And may Allah bless him and his family

Arabic text: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لَا حَدَّ لَهَا
Translation: After being pleased, with blessings that have no limit

Arabic text: وَلَا مُنْتَهَى يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: And no end, O Most Merciful of the merciful
